text_block_list.text: Are you ready? Then let's begin.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
However small the step, we must get
closer to perfecting the winning
equation...
There's nothing left to do but recalculate,
revise, and
reformulate!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
With the task of running in Нарита Брайан's
place left to her, Biwa
Hayahide is
determined to race in the Sprout Kinen.

However, given the high expectations for
Brian, this sudden change is
sure to
disappoint her fans.

But the erudite racer continues onward,
undeterred.

Though, to be honest, I would be lying if I
said I wasn't worried.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But I have hope... There are people who
believe I can prove my
theory and
complete the winning equation.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: And...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And what kind of big sister would I be if I
could not even keep a
promise to my
sister?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
That reminds me. Let me know if all this
brainstorming is making you
feel hungry.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I happen to have some curry I prepared
last night.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yes, the diced vegetables stewed quite
nicely... It's a nutritious curry
that even
picky eaters would enjoy.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Unable to resist the offer, we chow down
while working on the
equation, and time
flies by.

It's the day of the Sprout Kinen. Under a
perfectly clear sky, a throng
of spectators
come to the track to see the big race.

Good morning. The weather and wind
speed appear satisfactory.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I am in ideal shape to perform at my best.
Still...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'd like one final strategy meeting with
you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I have a complete rundown on our
opponents. The focus will be on
two in
particular.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We should expect the local favorite,
Through Passport, to be a
skilled front
runner. That was her running style for each
of the past
twelve scrimmages, you see.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And Titan Frypan will make a definite
move from the center. The
likelihood of a
late surge approach is incredibly high.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Their caution and mental strength are
rather... comparable to Brian's.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Perfect opponents? Hahaha, you sure are
confident. One might even
say optimistic.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Though I suppose this daring positivity of
yours does help ease my
tension.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: It's time... Shall we?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: (Brian... I hope you're watching.)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... All right! Watch me pick up the pace, Brian!
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text:
Wow! Me too, me too! I'm gonna catch
you, Sis!
text_block_list.name: Young Brian

text_block_list.text:
(Or since you left me behind already,
maybe you can't even see me
anymore.)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: (Never mind... That doesn't matter now.)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to show you... I'll make you
remember.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You'll remember what it was like trailing
behind me!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's fair blue skies today for the Sprout
Kinen! And these ten leaders
of the next
generation are sure going to give us a
fantastic show!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: (All right, an excellent start!)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Through Passport, the
experienced front runner, is
having some
trouble! She's dragging behind! What
could be wrong?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
And Бива Хаяхидэ, subbing for Narita
Brian, is pushing to the front!
Meanwhile,
the highly anticipated Titan Frypan has a
firm position in
the back!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: The results will be proof that I'm correct!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
My technique is my theory! The winning
equation!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
They're approaching the final corner! And
here comes Titan Frypan!
She's flying
around from the outside!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: I won't let you overtake me now!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Look at this! Бива Хаяхидэ pulls ahead!
How does she have the
stamina left after
staying in front for so long?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Watch me...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: You'll be the one trying to keep up, Brian!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ's leaving them behind!
What a tremendous sprint!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ! It's Бива Хаяхидэ! The big
name of the new
generation is Biwa
Hayahide!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
First place. Well, not surprising.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: As expected of my big sis.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Yeeeaaah! BIWA HAYAHIDE! That was an
amazing race, huh,
Taishin?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
So damn loud... Go bother someone else.
I'm leaving.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! W-w-wait a sec! Where are you
going?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I have to train.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Gasp! I get it! Seeing Hayahide got you all fired up! I know exactly how you feel!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm coming tooooo! It's training time!
Whoo-hooooo!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: That's not why... Hey! Quit following me!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
There... We've gotten the result we were
looking for.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
That's one step closer to completing the
winning equation.

text_block_list.text: Heheh... Indeed. But that means we still have a long way to go.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
No matter though... We will get there,
eventually.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
With that said, let's head back and get to
work!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Our days of trying to perfect the winning
equation together have
begun!
